title: DegenWrap
tagline: DegenWrap showcases hodlers a reflection of their nightmarish investments over the year 2022.
description:
It’s a fun project to experiment and Learn Crypto Data APIs.

- 2022 has been one of the craziest year, with DegenWrap we want everyone to recall their nightmarish investments and also realize we’ve survived the bear market and still building at this hackathon
how_its_made:
-  Learning Curve for Dune API

- While fetching data from Dune API, the results are not instant and there’s a time lag which makes it hard for end-users to show results in real-time.

- Most of the data is completely raw and not polished. So challenge was to fine tune the raw data and showcase something meaningful out of it.
